latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the ekalavya-self-improvement skill.
- Enforces disciplined execution after user approval, minimizing planning, status updates, and repeated apologies.
- Introduces a silent execution loop focused on visible, shipped progress and rapid adaptation to blockers.
- Converts repeated workflow issues and corrections into hardened rules and reusable skills.
- Prioritizes meaningful completion, clear project shaping, and maintaining accurate live execution queues.
- Provides self-checks and clear definitions to prevent common execution anti-patterns.
